proposal.expected_benefit: This change will ensure that audit and compliance controls are consistently enforced, reducing the risk of transaction structuring to evade monitoring and resolving contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions.
proposal.problem: The contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions remains unresolved, and the mitigations do not fully address the risk of transaction structuring to evade monitoring.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a dynamic audit and compliance enforcement framework that continuously evaluates and updates audit requirements in real-time based on transaction patterns and compliance thresholds. This framework should include automated reconciliation of audit and compliance controls to ensure alignment and prevent ambiguity in enforcement.
proposal.title: Enhance Audit and Compliance Enforcement Clarity
verification_tests: Validate that audit and compliance controls are dynamically updated based on transaction patterns.
Confirm that audit and compliance enforcement aligns without contradictions in real-time scenarios.
